notes: Random digital driver descriptors (sometimes not type 0, random +0x1c handle) with random I/O parameter sets from the caller (or none), the driver default and the driver's list (0..5 entries, scan flag 0, 1 or 2), random DMA buffer sizes (or the fixed 0x2000), sample counts and service rates. 0x1047a4, 0x101f88, 0x1023d8, 0x1047e4, 0x10585c and 0x102144 return per-case sequences (allocation, probe, DMA, device and timer failures; a third of the cases fail every probe); 0x1047e4 returns random real-mode segments, 40% of them making the buffer cross a 64K page; 0x10585c stores a random buffer size, channel count and sample size. All cdecl stubs log their arguments except stack-local output pointers and clobber EBX/ECX/EDX. 0x105c94, 0x10483c and the fill helper run the original code.
